mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT FROM ai_memory_source s JOIN ai_memory_dependency d ON d.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND d.source_id=s.id WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND d.target_type='MEMORY_VERSION' AND d.target_id=#{item} ORDER BY s.id
SELECT source_id FROM ai_memory_dependency WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND target_type='MEMORY_VERSION' AND target_id=#{item} ORDER BY source_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ai_memory_source s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT DISTINCT i.owner_id,i.domain,i.origin_top_agent_id,i.id AS item_id FROM ai_memory_source s JOIN ai_memory_decision d ON d.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND d.id=s.source_object_ref JOIN ai_memory_item i ON i.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND i.id=d.item_id WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.id=#{id} AND CAST(s.source_type AS BINARY)=_binary'USER_PREFERENCE_DECISION' AND d.actor_kind='USER' AND i.owner_id=d.actor_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM ai_memory_dependency d JOIN ai_memory_source s ON s.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND s.id=d.source_id WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND d.source_id IN #{sourceId} ORDER BY source_id,d.target_type,d.target_id,d.target_version FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM ai_memory_dependency d JOIN ai_memory_source s ON s.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND s.id=d.source_id WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND d.source_id=#{source} ORDER BY d.target_type,d.target_id,d.target_version FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_source SET grant_epoch=grant_epoch+1,source_epoch=source_epoch+1,deletion_epoch=deletion_epoch+1,retention_deadline=LEAST(COALESCE(retention_deadline,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE tenant_id=#{source.tenantId} AND id=#{source.id} AND grant_epoch=#{source.grantEpoch} AND source_epoch=#{source.sourceEpoch} AND deletion_epoch=#{source.deletionEpoch}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_memory_suppression(tenant_id,id,subject_type,subject_id,domain,scope_type,scope_id,purpose,field_key,suppression_kind,source_id,source_version) VALUES(#{item.tenantId},#{id},#{item.subjectType},#{item.subjectId},#{item.domain},#{item.scopeType},#{item.scopeId},#{item.purpose},#{item.fieldKey},'SOURCE',#{source.id},#{source.sourceVersion}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE epoch=IF(active=TRUE,epoch,epoch+1),active=TRUE
mapper.sql: tenant_id=#{item.tenantId} AND subject_type=#{item.subjectType} AND subject_id=#{item.subjectId} AND domain=#{item.domain} AND scope_type=#{item.scopeType} AND scope_id=#{item.scopeId} AND purpose=#{item.purpose} AND field_key=#{item.fieldKey} AND suppression_kind='FIELD'
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,id,suppression_kind,source_id,source_version,epoch,active FROM ai_memory_suppression WHERE FOR UPDATE
SELECT tenant_id,id,suppression_kind,source_id,source_version,epoch,active FROM ai_memory_suppression WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_memory_suppression(tenant_id,id,subject_type,subject_id,domain,scope_type,scope_id,purpose,field_key,suppression_kind) VALUES(#{item.tenantId},#{id},#{item.subjectType},#{item.subjectId},#{item.domain},#{item.scopeType},#{item.scopeId},#{item.purpose},#{item.fieldKey},'FIELD') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE epoch=IF(active=TRUE,epoch,epoch+1),active=TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_suppression SET active=FALSE,epoch=epoch+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND epoch=#{epoch} AND active=TRUE AND suppression_kind='FIELD'

UPDATE ai_memory_item SET current_version_id=NULL,lifecycle='DELETE_PENDING',revision=revision+1,grant_epoch=grant_epoch+1,source_epoch=source_epoch+1,deletion_epoch=deletion_epoch+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{item.tenantId} AND id=#{item.id} AND revision=#{item.revision} AND lifecycle IN ('LIVE','REVOKED','EXPIRED')

UPDATE ai_memory_version SET status='REVOKED',grant_epoch=GREATEST(grant_epoch,#{grant}),source_epoch=GREATEST(source_epoch,#{source}),deletion_epoch=GREATEST(deletion_epoch,#{deletion}) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND item_id=#{item} AND status<>'DELETED'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_memory_deletion_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ai_memory_deletion_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM ai_memory_deletion_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND item_id=#{item} AND deletion_epoch=#{epoch} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ai_memory_deletion_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND item_id=#{item} AND request_id=#{request} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_memory_suppression WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND source_id=#{source} AND source_version=#{version} AND suppression_kind='SOURCE' AND active=TRUE FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_deletion_job SET status=#{job.status},completed_targets=#{job.completedTargets},revision=revision+1,attempts=#{job.attempts},receipts=#{job.receipts} WHERE tenant_id=#{job.tenantId} AND id=#{job.id} AND revision=#{expected} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','BLOCKED','RETRYABLE_FAILED')

UPDATE ai_memory_version SET status='DELETED',encrypted_payload=NULL,nonce=NULL,auth_tag=NULL,content_hmac=NULL,scrubbed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND item_id=#{item} AND deletion_epoch=#{epoch} AND status='REVOKED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_memory_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND item_id=#{item} AND status<>'DELETED'
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_item SET lifecycle='DELETED',revision=revision+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{item} AND deletion_epoch=#{epoch} AND revision=#{revision} AND lifecycle='DELETE_PENDING' AND current_version_id IS NULL
UPDATE ai_memory_outbox SET status='SUCCEEDED',revision=revision+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event_id=#{event} AND status IN ('QUEUED','CLAIMED','BLOCKED')

UPDATE ai_memory_item SET current_version_id=#{version},lifecycle='LIVE',revision=revision+1,grant_epoch=grant_epoch+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{item.tenantId} AND id=#{item.id} AND revision=#{item.revision} AND lifecycle='DELETED' AND current_version_id IS NULL
